_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05 (batch S10). Agio Z4 is the US-market Agio-branded (Peg Perego) four-wheel reversible modular stroller; the same product is also sold as Peg Perego 'Ypsi'. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Agio Z4:YPSI Full-Feature Reversible Stroller (by Peg Perego)

clekListed.clekRow: Peg Perego Agio Z4:YPSI — Agio car seat adapter for Z4 stroller (IKCS0018)

specs._dimsNote: Agio Baby lists open 20 x 39.25 x 40.25 in and folded 20 x 32.25 x 15.25 in; consistent with Strollberry metric (open 100 cm L x 51 cm W x 102 cm H; folded 82 x 52 x 38.5 cm).

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth (with infant car seat or bassinet); reversible seat from ~6 mo+

safety.standards: US-market stroller; complies with ASTM F833 / 16 CFR 1227 (specific rated limits not separately published by Agio)
safety.certifications: Not separately published by Agio/Peg Perego on the US product page
safety.notes: 5-point harness; reversible seat (parent- or world-facing); full recline to lie-flat; spring suspension on all wheels.

recall.note: The Z4/YPSI STROLLER itself was not recalled. Related accessory recall: Peg Perego recalled the YPSI and Z4 Inclined Sleeper Bassinet accessory (sold July 2022–April 2023, ~550 units) on 2023-11-30 for suffocation/fall hazard (incline >10 degrees; violates Safe Sleep for Babies Act). Remedy is disabling the bassinet backrest recline, not the stroller frame/seat.

specs.foldType: one-hand compact fold, self-standing (folds with seat attached)
specs.tires: four rubber-coated swivel/lockable wheels (~18 cm front / 27 cm rear) with internal spring suspension

notes: Current-gen Agio (Peg Perego US brand) four-wheel reversible, modular stroller; identical product to Peg Perego 'Ypsi' (hence Clek's 'Z4:YPSI' row). ~22.5 lb, one-hand self-standing fold, reversible seat with lie-flat recline, converts single-to-double. Confirmed on Clek's official Liing/Liingo list; Clek Liing attaches via the Agio Z4/Ypsi adapter IKCS0018 (adapter-ikcs0018). MSRP $749.99 (Agio Baby DTC, out of stock at check); in stock at Baby Grand for $599 (sale). Basket capacity and JPMA certification not separately published — left null.
